data.name: The Anointed: Heart of David
data.detailed_description:
The Anointed: Heart of David is a third-person, single-player action-adventure game blending platforming, stealth, and biblical history. Step into the sandals of David, a young shepherd boy destined for greatness. With wisdom, skill, and bravery, you will navigate the iconic events and landscapes of Ancient Israel on his journey from shepherd to king.

Explore a linear narrative rich with hidden paths, secrets, and vertical environments. Traverse long distances from Bethlehem on horseback, or move on foot using a robust movement system to walk, crawl, crouch, sprint, jump, vault, scale walls, and swing from ropes.

Defend yourself against wild animals, Philistine forces, and dangerous adversaries using David’s classic arsenal: a sling, staff, sword, and spear. While combat is always an option, utilizing stealth provides the most rewarding strategy.

Guide your journey using historical Dialogues and Scripture Scrolls, and overcome tough challenges with "Prayer Tip" video guides. Instead of traditional meters, manage unique stats—Vitality, Righteousness, and Empowerment—that reflect David's character. Instead of Skill and Experience points, this game measures the player's growth with Traits like: Discipline, Obedience, Courage, Patience, and Humility.

Bonus Multiplayer Demo Included:
Get a sneak peek at Champions of David, a multiplayer demo where you can play solo or team up with friends to control David’s legendary allies.

data.short_description: The Anointed: Heart of David is a single-player, action-adventure game with platforming elements experienced in 3rd-person perspective. Step into the sandals of David, a young boy destined for greatness. With wisdom, skill, and bravery, navigate the iconic events and landscapes of Ancient Israel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Check Options/Video settings to improve performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i9 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 64 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Check Options/Video settings to improve performance.
